title: Explore Dubs and Samples
description: Use the separate vaults, recognise media colours and find your own samples and packs.

steps.caption: 1. Dub Vault groups releases into pack cards, keeping their files together.
2. Open Samples for the green Sample Vault. Published Sample Packs classify their files as samples.
3. Expand a Sample Pack to see its ordered files without leaving the vault.
4. Your Samples contains your own sample releases and their pack management tools.
5. Use Packs to manage drafts and published Sample Packs; Dubs has its own matching workspace.
